meeting.description: A Feishu Minutes or VC object.

note_doc_token.description: The document token of the meeting notes.

verbatim_doc_token.description: The document token of the verbatim transcript.

relatedArtifacts.description: The meeting's related artifacts, as Feishu returns them. A token is absent without its permission and an empty string until the document exists.

description: The requested meeting, and its related artifacts when includeArtifacts is set.
